module: Framing node "painting" tool for vehicle thumbnails. It lets you disable (or re-enable) vehicle nodes with a circular brush in the editor's 3D view, so that they are ignored by procedural framing (antennas, protruding parts…). The list of disabled nodes is saved per configuration (key "model/config") in /settings/thumbnailNodeOutpaintConfig.json, in the configs table. It also provides the node data used by framing/procedural (world position, name, ignoreForThumbnailFraming mark, automatic detection of external mirrors), the editor's undo/redo history and debug drawing functions.
notes: Config file format: {configs = {["model/config"] = {[cid as string] = node name}}}. A config with no disabled node is removed from the table.
The config key is normalized: the last path segment, without the .pc or .jpg extension.

The brush (updateBrush) acts only if the tab is active, the "Enable node brush" box is checked, no capture job is running and the mouse hovers the editor's 3D view; Ctrl + left click re-enables nodes. Radius: 4 to 80 px.
Debug colors: cyan = active, red = manually disabled, purple = ignored by the part (ignoreForThumbnailFraming), orange = automatic external mirror.
Changes go through editor.history (undo/redo) when the editor is loaded; the config is written to disk on every change.
Nodes are tables {cid, key, name, ignoreForThumbnailFraming, automaticMirrorOutpaint, point}; key is the cid converted to a string.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: ui_imgui, ui_imguiUtils, core_camera, core_vehicle_manager, util_screenshotCreator_settings.

getConfigPath.desc: Returns the path of the configuration file (/settings/thumbnailNodeOutpaintConfig.json).

loadConfig.desc: Loads the configuration file into memory (only once unless force); creates an empty table if the file is missing or invalid.

force.desc: true to reread the file even if it is already loaded.

saveConfig.desc: Writes the configuration to disk (jsonWriteFile, indented).

getVehicleOutpaintKey.desc: Computes the "model/config" key of a vehicle, from its jbeam and explicitConfigName or vehicle.partConfig (normalized).

explicitConfigName.desc: Imposed config name (takes priority over partConfig).

returns.desc: "model/config" key, nil if the model or the config is missing.

getVehicleNodeData.desc: Lists all the vehicle's physical nodes with their world position and marks. On the first call, runs the mirror detection selfCheck.

returns.desc: Array of {cid, key, name, ignoreForThumbnailFraming, automaticMirrorOutpaint, point (world vec3)}.

getVehicleNode.desc: Looks up a vehicle node by key (cid as string), by name or by cid.

getDisabledNodes.desc: Returns the table of disabled nodes of a config ({cid string = name}). Returns an unregistered empty table if the config does not exist, unless create is true.

explicitConfigName.desc: Imposed config name when the first argument is a vehicle.

create.desc: true to create and register the config's table in memory.

getDisabledNodesForKey.desc: Shortcut of getDisabledNodes for a config key.

create.desc: true to create the table if absent.

setNodeDisabled.desc: Disables or re-enables a node for a config, with an undo/redo history entry and saving to disk.

node.desc: Node (with key and name), as returned by getVehicleNode.

disabled.desc: true to disable, false to re-enable.

enableAll.desc: Re-enables all the nodes of a config (removes its entry) with history and saving.

returns.desc: false if there were no disabled nodes or no key.

applySnapshot.desc: Replaces the disabled nodes of a config with a snapshot (or removes the entry if empty) and saves. Used by undo/redo.

undo.desc: Undoes a change: applies actionData.old. editor.history callback.

redo.desc: Redoes a change: applies actionData.new. editor.history callback.

beginUiFrame.desc: Resets tabActive to false at the start of each UI frame; drawTab sets it back to true if the tab is displayed.

setTabActive.desc: Forces the "tab active" state; disabling it ends the brush stroke in progress.

value.desc: true if the tab is active.

isTabActive.desc: Indicates whether the brush tab is active.

drawTab.desc: Draws the tab's ImGui content: brush checkbox, radius, color legend, "Auto-frame vehicle" button (if options.autoFrame exists), list of disabled nodes with an Enable button and "Enable all".

updateBrush.desc: Updates the brush every frame: draws the circle, colors the nodes in the 3D view (debugDrawer), and during a left click disables the nodes under the brush (Ctrl: re-enables them). The brush stroke is recorded as a history action at the end.

finishStroke.desc: Ends the brush stroke in progress: if it modified nodes, records the "Paint Thumbnail Framing Nodes" action in the history and saves.

drawFramingDebug.desc: Draws the framing data as 3D debug: bounds box (orange), vehicle OOBB (cyan), center, look-at point, axes, framing points, mirror nodes and disabled nodes, with labels. Default options come from settings.getFramingContext().debug.

framingData.desc: framingData returned by a framing mode.

drawVehicleNodes.desc: Draws a small debug sphere on each vehicle node, colored according to its state (ignored, disabled, mirror, active).

selfCheck.desc: Assertion test of the external mirror detection.

deserialize.desc: Restores the brush state (also accepts the old keys nodeOutpaintEnabled and nodeOutpaintBrushRadius); radius clamped to 4..80.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook after reload; identical to deserialize.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: loads the configuration when the extension is loaded.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: ends the brush stroke in progress on unload.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle spawns: ends the brush stroke in progress.
